title: Kingdom Hearts arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2002, Kingdom Hearts became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2002, Kingdom Hearts became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the role-playing category, Kingdom Hearts broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
